strings: Solomon's Law is a local decree issued through Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall. It condemns the Shadowhide gnolls of Redridge to death for colluding with Morganth, an enemy of Stormwind. Adventurers are tasked with enforcing the town's harsh frontier justice by bringing back pendants taken from the gnolls.

Lakeshire stands largely isolated from Stormwind's immediate military support, forcing Magistrate Solomon and his town officials to govern Redridge with strict frontier authority. Operating out of the town hall, Bailiff Conacher serves as the arm of the local magistrate court. When external threats menace the township, the court has little recourse other than putting bounties on offenders' heads, relying on freelance mercenaries and traveling defenders to uphold the kingdom's statutes.
Aiding an Enemy of the Crown

The legal justification for exterminating the Shadowhide clan rests on their alliance with Morganth, a rogue spellcaster entrenched in the eastern hills. Under the laws of Lakeshire and the Kingdom of Stormwind, directly aiding a declared enemy of the realm carries a mandatory sentence of death. Because the gnolls actively carry out Morganth's bidding, the court regards them not merely as wild scavengers, but as treasonous belligerents subject to execution.

Leaders of the Fang is a pivotal Horde quest tasked by Nara Wildmane from the heights of Thunder Bluff. It directs adventurers into the Wailing Caverns to strike down the four leaders of the corrupted Druids of the Fang and retrieve their twisted dream gems. Halting these rogue druids is essential to preventing their serpentine nightmare from permanently overtaking the Barrens.

The night elf druid Naralex ventured into the subterranean springs of the Wailing Caverns with a selfless ambition: to use the Emerald Dream to restore lush vitality to the arid Barrens. Tragically, when his slumber took root, his dream turned into a waking nightmare. The acolytes who accompanied him lost their devotion to nature's harmony, succumbing to the nightmare's corruption and adopting the mantle of the Druids of the Fang.

To reshape the Barrens into their own viperous Eden, the leaders of the splintered sect channel the warped dream energies through specialized foci known as dream gems. Lord Cobrahn, Lady Anacondra, Lord Pythas, and Lord Serpentis each bear one of these gems. As long as these artifacts remain in their grasp, their corrupting influence will seep outward into the soil and waters of Kalimdor.
